'''Tyfor Renadal''' was a public relations specialist living during the [[Galactic War]]. After his company [[Renadal Consulting]] collapsed, Tyfor ended up on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], homeless and starving, unable to afford a simple [[Sonic shower/Legends|sonic shower]]. One day, he spotted from a gutter grate as a Republic hero, under the guise of a cannibalistic [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Red Hulls]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], spared a [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] named [[Grumm]] who challenged the Republic hero in battle. Tyfor then send a later to the person he believed to be a cannibal, offering his services in public relations.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{C|Letter only}}
